MuJoCo will independently re-run the original creature and each valid proposal on fresh random seeds, and ALSO a matched-random edit of the same size and a simple rule-based heuristic. A change is adopted only if it beats the original significantly; your confidence is never used. So diagnose carefully and honestly. If no change is likely to help, say so: give low confidence (<= 0.2) on your best small proposal instead of guessing.

A change smaller than this is recorded as not verified even if it helps a little, so size each edit to the effect you predict (within the edit rules below).

- leg_density [morphology; targets both] density of every leg segment incl. feet (kg/m^3)
- foot_friction [morphology; targets both] foot-floor Coulomb friction coefficient
- torque_limit [actuation; targets both] motor torque limit of every joint (N*m)
- stand.kp [control; targets both] joint position-gain (N*m/rad) of the standing PD controller
- stand.kd [control; targets both] joint damping gain (N*m*s/rad) of the standing PD controller
